Table 16. Percent of suicides in federal prisons, by demographic characteristics of prisoners, 2015–19

Note: Includes deaths in Federal Bureau of Prisons (BOP) facilities and excludes deaths in privately operated federal facilities. As of December 30, 2001, sentenced felons from the District of Columbia were the responsibility of the BOP. Details may not sum to totals due to rounding and missing data. Data may have been revised from previously published statistics. See Methodology.
a/Excludes persons of Hispanic origin (e.g., “white” refers to non-Hispanic whites and “black” refers to non-Hispanic blacks).
b/Includes persons of two or more races or other unspecified races.
Source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, Federal Law Enforcement Agency Deaths in Custody Reporting Program, 2015–19.
